mapper.select: SELECT id, uuid, project_list_id AS projectListId, material_id AS materialId, material_code AS materialCode, item_name AS itemName, model, brand, unit, quantity, unit_price AS unitPrice, total_amount AS totalAmount, source_type AS sourceType, remark, create_time AS createTime, create_user AS createUser, update_time AS updateTime, update_user AS updateUser FROM project_list_item WHERE uuid = #{uuid}

SELECT id, uuid, project_list_id AS projectListId, material_id AS materialId, material_code AS materialCode, item_name AS itemName, model, brand, unit, quantity, unit_price AS unitPrice, total_amount AS totalAmount, source_type AS sourceType, remark, create_time AS createTime, create_user AS createUser, update_time AS updateTime, update_user AS updateUser FROM project_list_item WHERE project_list_id = #{projectListId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_list_item ( uuid, project_list_id, material_id, material_code, item_name, model, brand, unit, quantity, unit_price, total_amount, source_type, remark, create_time, create_user ) VALUES ( #{uuid}, #{projectListId}, #{materialId}, #{materialCode}, #{itemName}, #{model}, #{brand}, #{unit}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{totalAmount}, #{sourceType}, #{remark}, NOW(), #{createUser} )
